content:
Upgrading to a new phone often comes with a hidden cost: having to replace your protective case when the new and old models are different sizes.

For users upgrading from last year's Pro model to the iPhone 18 Pro, this seems very likely to happen—but two accessory manufacturers don't think so, and one of them is quite confident about it...

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman posted a photo on Twitter of an Otterbox case already on sale at Best Buy, saying it is compatible with both the iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro. The bottom right corner of the packaging reads in English and French:

Compatible with iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 17 Pro

Gurman himself wasn't entirely sure, adding the comment "too early." But Matt Ronge of Astropad—their company specializes in anti-reflective screen protectors for iPhones—said his suppliers have told him the same thing.

Conflicting reports on iPhone Pro thickness

Last year, a leaker indicated that at least the iPhone 18 Pro Max would be thicker and heavier than its predecessor. That report didn't mention the smaller Pro model, but materials leaked from an iPhone supplier suggest the iPhone 18 Pro will be two millimeters thicker than the previous generation.

This trend seems to be continuing, as both iPhone 17 Pro models are thicker and heavier than their predecessors.

However, not all leakers agree—some say the iPhone 18 Pro Max will be exactly the same thickness as last year's model.

9to5Mac's perspective

Apple does sometimes provide dimensional information early to long-time case manufacturer partners, so third-party cases can launch alongside new phones. On the other hand, accessory makers sometimes just take a gamble based on rumors, and sometimes they guess wrong. Personally, I wouldn't place an order for a case before the new phone is announced.
